text: Make a vertical poster and a matching 8-second reel for our night market. Both should say: “Night Market”, “Saturday 12 July”, “6–10 pm”, “Riverside Yard”, “Free entry”. Warm illustrated food stalls and string lights, please. Keep all the details readable throughout the reel, with a little animation behind them. No sound. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so please tell me what this will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?
